title: Dependency verification is checksum-only (trust on first use)
detail: gradle/verification-metadata.xml pins SHA-256 for every artifact, generated from the first download; PGP signatures are not verified yet. Plan: enable verify-signatures with a trusted-keys list in M1.

title: Cloud SessionStart hook runs a repository script
detail: A branch that edits tools/cloud/setup-android.sh or .claude/settings.json would run that code in a cloud session opened on it. CODEOWNERS now requires the owner's review for .claude/, tools/cloud/, .github/ and gradle/; branch protection on main is recommended.

title: Admin screens open in every debug build until sign-in exists
detail: Until Sign in with Google (F019, M1) the admin screens are gated by BuildConfig.DEBUG. They show only the public catalog and audit log; the gate is documented as a convenience, not a security boundary.

title: Pre-release UI dependency
detail: material3 1.5.0-beta01 is used above the Compose BOM (1.4.0) because Material 3 Expressive is public only from 1.5. Tracked in libs.versions.toml; back to the BOM when 1.5.0 is stable.

title: Cloud SDK download verified with SHA-1
detail: tools/cloud/setup-android.sh checks the Android command-line tools against the SHA-1 Google publishes in its repository index (the only checksum offered), fetched over HTTPS from the same host.
